story_type: Navy destroyer fires an interceptor at a ballistic missile target at night
hook: This destroyer fired a missile to hit another missile.
narration: This destroyer fired a missile to hit another missile.
In October twenty eighteen, a target ballistic missile launched from the Pacific Missile Range Facility on Kauai, Hawaii.
Out at sea, the USS John Finn picked it up and tracked it with its own SPY-1 radar.
Then the ship launched a Standard Missile Three Block Two A straight up out of its deck.
It carries no explosive warhead. It simply rams the target.
[short pause] Tracking cameras followed the interceptor as it raced up to meet the target.
outcome: The SM-3 intercepted the target missile.
title: Destroyer fires a missile at a missile
description:
The USS John Finn (DDG 113) launches a Standard Missile-3 Block IIA that intercepts a ballistic missile target launched from the Pacific Missile Range Facility, Kauai, Hawaii, during Flight Test Standard Missile-45 on Oct. 26, 2018.
